description: Measures the smallest clearance between the parts in a 3MF or OBJ, to judge whether a print-in-place mechanism will fuse when printed. Parts that touch each other are first merged into rigid bodies before comparing, because Bambu also stores the colour-change segments of a single solid as separate parts; without merging, one piece would be reported as "clearance 0". When the clearance is too small it suggests compensation, distinguishing outer contours from holes (the enclosed side is a hole to the slicer and is controlled by a different parameter). STL has no part boundaries, so it cannot be measured. No side effects.

minimumClearanceMm.description: The smallest clearance that prints reliably. Defaults to 0.15 (the practical lower limit for PLA with a 0.4 mm nozzle).

modelPath.description: Absolute path to a 3MF or OBJ file; it must be inside an allowed model directory.

reportThresholdMm.description: Part pairs farther apart than this are left out of the report. Defaults to 2 mm.

samplingMm.description: Surface sampling spacing; smaller is more accurate but slower. Defaults to 0.2 mm.

name: bambu_measure_clearance
title: Measure clearance between parts
